description: Persistent repository of ATS autofill failure patterns, root causes, and verified fixes.

lessons.symptom: State machine stuck on Overview or misclassifying Job Overview page as auth_sign_in.
lessons.root_cause: Broad 'button:has-text(Sign In)' selector matched the global navbar 'Sign In' header button on the job overview page before checking for applyButton.
lessons.fix_rule: Prioritize applyButton for 'overview' when password input is absent; strictly target button[data-automation-id='signInSubmitButton'] inside auth container.

lessons.symptom: Combobox selecting transient loading spinner instead of real option.
lessons.root_cause: Async React-Select combobox displays .select__menu-notice--loading while fetching suggestions.

lessons.symptom: Autofill halts after credential entry on Workday.
lessons.root_cause: Workday post-auth redirect lands back on /job/... overview page, requiring an authenticated 'Apply' click before Stage 3 mounts.
lessons.fix_rule: Use state machine loop (max 20 transitions) that handles overview -> modal -> auth -> overview -> info dynamically.

lessons.symptom: Red validation outlines persist after filling inputs.
lessons.root_cause: Setting input value without synthetic event dispatch leaves internal React/Angular state uncommitted.
lessons.fix_rule: Always dispatch 'input', 'change', and 'blur' events on modified form elements.

lessons.symptom: Phone dial code matches British Indian Ocean Territory (+246) instead of India (+91).
lessons.root_cause: Substring search for 'India' matches territory name before country name.
lessons.fix_rule: Search and match exact dial code string '+91' before fallback to country name.

lessons.symptom: State classified as 'unknown' and radio options unchecked on live Workday 'My Information' stage.
lessons.root_cause: Live Workday uses BEM IDs ('name--legalName--firstName', 'address--addressLine1') without data-automation-id, radio buttons use boolean value='false' with sibling labels, and Save & Continue uses pageFooterNextButton.
lessons.fix_rule: Match dual-tier selectors (BEM IDs + data-automation-id), group radio inputs by name with value='false'/'true' and sibling label[for] resolution, and recognize pageFooterNextButton.

lessons.symptom: Repeated transitions stuck on Stage 1 ('My Information') without advancing due to tenant-specific custom fields or strict validation errors.
lessons.root_cause: Workday state machine excluded 'info' and 'experience' from stuck counting, cycling indefinitely instead of yielding control to the user.
lessons.fix_rule: Enforce universal state_stuck_count >= 2 threshold triggering Human-in-the-Loop Manual Takeover Mode with audible chime (\a), candidate cheat sheet terminal card, DOM widget injection, and background submission confirmation listener.

lessons.symptom: Clicking 'View LinkedIn Post' results in HTTP 404 / 'Page not found'
lessons.root_cause: Content search cards lack data-urn on outer container, triggering fallback to synthetic MD5 hash URL in /feed/update/{hash} which LinkedIn 404s
lessons.fix_rule: Use multi-tier extraction (canonical /posts/ links, data-urn regex, React Fiber SDUI props, anchor regex) and fallback strictly to authentic author activity feeds (/recent-activity/all/ or /posts/), completely eradicating synthetic MD5 hash URLs

lessons.symptom: Shortlinks (lnkd.in) broken with 404, and posts misclassified as Dream Orgs
lessons.root_cause: 1. In DOM text extraction, link anchors were followed by next words/emojis without whitespace (e.g. lnkd.in/xxxFollow), and regex greedily captured them. 2. Substring matching for dream companies across raw headlines matched technical skill keywords (e.g. Docker, Postman).
lessons.fix_rule: 1. Extract DOM anchor hrefs directly; strictly isolate 5-8 char tokens for lnkd.in shortlinks and strip trailing action words (Follow, Apply, Note, Post, Click, If) and emojis. 2. Disambiguate technical tool keywords from employer company names; require explicit employer prepositions (at, @) and match against verified target companies.

lessons.symptom: Job seeker posts slipping through filter and conversational fragments extracted as company names
lessons.root_cause: Substring search for 'our team is hiring' matched 'if your team is hiring' (y-our team). Conversational prefixes ('if your team', 'several exciting') matched greedy regex.
lessons.fix_rule: Enforce strict word boundaries (\bour team is hiring\b), translate unicode small caps (Oᴘᴇɴ ᴛᴏ Wᴏʀᴋ), filter leading conversational stopwords, and run automatic SQLite repair migration.

lessons.symptom: Greenhouse Remix React-Select comboboxes fail to select Yes/No or take >12s, and el.closest('[role=combobox]') returns empty current_value.
lessons.root_cause: 1. Phone input intl-tel-input injects 245 hidden li.iti__country[role='option'] elements at the top of the DOM (with British Indian Ocean Territory at index 30 and India at index 98). 2. Multi-select comboboxes (question_*[]) stay open after option click and block subsequent comboboxes unless Escape is pressed. 3. el.closest('.select__control, [role=combobox]') matches the inner <input role='combobox'> itself rather than the outer .select__control wrapper.
lessons.fix_rule: 1. Exclude :not(.iti__country) from generic [role='option'] locators and check opt.is_visible(). 2. Press ArrowDown to open Remix React-Select menus and Escape after selecting on multi-selects. 3. Use el.closest('.select__control, .select__container, .select, .field') to read .select__single-value and .select__multi-value__label.

lessons.symptom: Lever hCaptcha fails verification ('There was an error verifying your application') in automation Chrome while working in native Chrome; #location-input cleared after resume upload.
lessons.root_cause: 1. context.add_init_script(STEALTH_EVASION_JS) and page.add_init_script('window.alert = ...') injected Page.addScriptToEvaluateOnNewDocument into cross-origin newassets.hcaptcha.com iframes and defined an own-property 'webdriver' on the navigator instance (detectable via Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(navigator, 'webdriver')). 2. Launching via launch_persistent_context passed Playwright internal flags. 3. Lever's async resume parser clears #location-input 1.5s after PDF upload.
lessons.fix_rule: 1. Spawn native macOS Google Chrome directly via subprocess.Popen with --disable-blink-features=AutomationControlled and attach over CDP without add_init_script in headful mode. 2. In STEALTH_EVASION_JS, skip cross-origin CAPTCHA iframes and only patch Navigator.prototype.webdriver when true. 3. Restore input#location-input in _sanitize_post_resume_parse().

lessons.symptom: Workday Application Questions dropdown 'Are you currently authorized to work in the country where this position is based?' selected 'India' instead of 'Yes'; Jabil filled city into address--cityLocal.
lessons.root_cause: 1. Generic dropdown_rules matched substring 'country' before explicit work-authorization regexes in _resolve_workday_questions(). 2. input[id*='city'] matched input#address--cityLocal before input#address--city.
lessons.fix_rule: 1. Evaluate explicit work authorization, sponsorship, and employment history regexes BEFORE generic dropdown_rules in _resolve_workday_questions(). 2. Scope Workday city selector to input[id*='city']:not([id*='Local']).

lessons.symptom: Lever Invisible hCaptcha returns 'There was an error verifying your application. Please try again.' and #location-input / #selected-location get wiped on blur.
lessons.root_cause: 1. retrieveLocations.js listens to input on #location-input to set .dropdown-container display:block, and on blur wipes both #location-input and #selected-location if .dropdown-container is visible. 2. Passing --disable-blink-features=AutomationControlled to native Chrome is unnecessary when --enable-automation is absent and triggers Chrome's flag warning banner. 3. Keeping Playwright CDP WebSocket (Runtime.enable) attached during #btn-submit click degrades Invisible hCaptcha trust score.
lessons.fix_rule: 1. Upload resume first and wait for /parseResume to populate resumeStorageId and #selected-location; keep .dropdown-container display:none and never dispatch input+blur on #location-input. 2. Launch native Chrome without --disable-blink-features=AutomationControlled. 3. Detach Playwright CDP (await p.stop()) immediately after staging so 0 debuggers are connected when user clicks SUBMIT APPLICATION.

lessons.symptom: Concurrent multi-tab worker overwrites tab URL with another worker's popup; ABB Workday pauses on Prefix ('Mr' without period) and Voluntary Disclosures genderIdentities pill.
lessons.root_cause: 1. page.context.on('page') listens globally across all concurrent workers in the browser context instead of only popups opened by that page. 2. ABB Workday uses 'Mr' (without trailing period) in Prefix options and input#personalInfoPerson--genderIdentities selectinput on Voluntary Disclosures.
lessons.fix_rule: 1. Strictly use page.on('popup') instead of page.context.on('page') when clicking Apply buttons in concurrent tabs. 2. Add prefix_val.rstrip('.') fallback for Workday Prefix dropdowns and populate input#personalInfoPerson--genderIdentities with 'Male' on Voluntary Disclosures.

lessons.symptom: Darwinbox login/register inputs return 0 controls in document.querySelectorAll('input'); Oracle Taleo pauses on Privacy Agreement ('✔ I have read') and Guest Apply email entry.
lessons.root_cause: 1. Darwinbox encapsulates inputs inside <dbx-textinput> Shadow DOM web components and renders Sign Up as a text span. 2. Oracle Taleo uses <input type='button' id='dialogTemplate-dialogForm-StatementBeforeAuthentificationContent-ContinueButton' value='✔ I have read'> followed by input#dialogTemplate-dialogForm-email + Continue.
lessons.fix_rule: 1. Traverse open .shadowRoot trees in record_flight_snapshot() and use Playwright shadow-piercing locators (input[placeholder*='email' i], text='Sign Up') on Darwinbox. 2. Advance Oracle Taleo through Apply as Guest -> StatementBeforeAuthentificationContent-ContinueButton -> dialogForm-email + Continue -> resume upload.
